newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Bancrecer to back units' convertible debs.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Bancrecer to back units' convertible debs.

text.p: Mexico's Grupo Financiero Bancrecer said Wednesday it would back an issue of convertible debentures worth up to 600 million pesos by its Bancrecer bank and up to 400 million pesos by its recently acquired Banoro bank.

"The financial group is backing these debentures to bolster its revenue and at the same time cover some debt obligations that it issued in the past," a Bancrecer official said in a report issued through the Mexican stock exchange.
The debentures will be convertible into Bancrecer A and B shares at rate of 1.5 times book value.
